sections.title: Matches
sections.intro: These examples return the expected cards with accurate outlines and crops.

cases.title: Plain background
cases.description: A single card on a plain green surface.

cases.title: Rotated card
cases.description: The card is rotated 42 degrees; the crop is straightened.

cases.title: Mild blur
cases.description: Mild simulated defocus leaves enough of the border to extract the card.

cases.title: Dim light
cases.description: The faint outer border is recovered; the crop keeps the image's original brightness.

cases.title: Several separate cards
cases.description: Four separated cards are returned as four separate crops.

cases.title: Partly hidden corner
cases.description: The outline is recovered around a partly hidden corner; the finger remains in the crop.

cases.title: Oblique view
cases.description: A simulated camera pitched 65 degrees still returns the full card.

cases.title: Card back
cases.description: An original patterned card back can be extracted without knowing the card's identity.

cases.title: Busy playmat
cases.description: The visible dark border is recovered outside the inner printed frame, despite the busy background.

cases.title: White border on a playmat
cases.description: A white-border Lightning Bolt keeps its full printed border against a busy mat.

cases.title: Silver border on a playmat
cases.description: A silver-border Booster Tutor is extracted along its physical edge, including the pale frame.

cases.title: Clear sleeve
cases.description: The card inside the clear sleeve is extracted without the surrounding plastic margin; the reflection remains.

cases.title: White border in a sleeve
cases.description: The pale card frame is separated from the wider sleeve outline.

cases.title: Silver border in a sleeve
cases.description: The silver printed border is retained while the surrounding sleeve margin is removed.

sections.title: Misses and wrong crops
sections.intro: Returning an image does not guarantee a good extraction. These examples either miss cards or return the wrong outline.

cases.title: Stacked cards
cases.description: Neither card is found in this overlapping pair.

cases.title: Overlapping cards
cases.description: Two crops are returned, but their outlines do not match the two full cards.

cases.title: Outside the frame
cases.description: The card runs beyond the image edge; the returned crop has the wrong outline.

sections.title: False matches
sections.intro: There are no cards in these inputs. Card-shaped objects can still produce crops.

cases.title: Empty sleeve
cases.description: An empty sleeve has no card, but its outline produces a crop.

cases.title: Printed card zones
cases.description: The empty mat's printed markings produce a crop even though no card is present.

sections.title: Correct non-matches
sections.intro: These objects are correctly rejected. No crops are returned.

cases.title: Tall phone
cases.description: This tall phone is rejected because its outline has the wrong proportions.

cases.title: Square paper
cases.description: The square paper is rejected by the trading-card proportion filter.
